blurb: Tofino Air offers year-round seaplane experiences ranging from 30 to 90 minute scenic flights over coastlines, inlets, and glaciers, as well as longer half-day trips to Hot Springs Cove. They also provide wheeled plane tours and charter services to waterfront destinations typically accessible only by boat. Scheduled seasonal daily flights connect Victoria Airport and Tofino-Long Beach Airport.
